caption: your evening meal keeps you awake #usahealth #wellness #wellnessjourney #tcm
transcript: Your evening meal is keeping you awake. Eating a heavy meal, especially later in the evening, forces your body to work. It works to digest. When your body works, it cannot truly rest. Consider a warm, clear soup instead. Simple soup, easy to digest. Your stomach can then quiet down. Your body can begin its journey toward sleep. It is a gentle invitation to deeper rest. A light evening soup allows your body to prepare for stillness. I wrote more about this in my book, The Body Remembers How to Eat. For those who wish to go deeper, take a look.
